questions.question: What does Wisdom say about her origin in Proverbs 8?
options: The LORD possessed her at the beginning of his work, before creation
She was the very last of all the things that God brought into being
She has no beginning at all that any living creature could ever once trace
She first arose long ago out of the minds of the wise men of old
questions.answer: The LORD possessed her at the beginning of his work, before creation

questions.question: Wisdom declares that whoever finds her finds life and obtains favor from the LORD.
